title: Reefer Cargo Services: plug-in fee reduction for service contract holders
content:
## Scope

This clause of **Reefer Cargo Services** sets when a customer's service contract with the company reduces the terminal plug-in fees of a reefer service, and by how much. It affects the plug-in fees only.

## Rule

1. When the customer holds an **active** service contract whose tier rank is at least the reefer tier's minimum contract rank, and that minimum rank is not 0, the plug-in fees are reduced by the reefer tier's discount percentage.
2. The reduced fee is rounded to the cent.
3. A minimum rank of 0 means the reefer tier grants no plug-in discount.

## Tier table

| Reefer tier | Lowest service contract tier rank that qualifies | Plug-in fee reduction |
|---|---|---|
| AHL Reefer Standard | 0 (no discount on this tier) | 0 percent |
| AHL Reefer Monitored | 4 | 5 percent |
| AHL Reefer Cold Treatment | 4 | 5 percent |
| AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere | 4 | 10 percent |
| AHL Reefer Pharma GDP | 4 | 10 percent |
| AHL Reefer Superfreezer | 4 | 5 percent |

## What is held, in what state, with what effect

| Element | Content |
|---|---|
| What the customer holds | A service contract with the company |
| In what state | Active |
| Qualifying level | Contract tier rank at least the reefer tier's minimum rank, the minimum rank not being 0 |
| Effect | The plug-in fees of the reefer service are reduced by the reefer tier's percentage, rounded to the cent |

## Truth table

| Active service contract | Contract rank at least the minimum | Reefer tier's minimum rank | Plug-in discount |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Not 0 | Applied |
| Yes | No | Not 0 | Not applied: the rank is below the lowest qualifying rank |
| Any | Any | 0 | Not applied: the tier grants none |

## Worked examples (hypothetical amounts)

> **AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere**, customer with an active service contract of tier rank 5. A hypothetical undiscounted plug-in fee of 195.00 USD is reduced by 10 percent, which is 19.50 USD, leaving 175.50 USD.

> **AHL Reefer Monitored**, customer with an active service contract of tier rank 4. A hypothetical undiscounted plug-in fee of 170.31 USD is reduced by 5 percent, which is 8.5155 USD; the reduced fee of 161.7945 USD is rounded to the cent, giving 161.79 USD.

> **AHL Reefer Pharma GDP**, customer whose service contract has tier rank 3. The rank is below 4, so the plug-in fee is not reduced.

> **AHL Reefer Standard**, customer with an active service contract of any rank. The tier's minimum rank is 0, so no discount applies.

## Basis Q&A

**Does the reduction apply to the pre-trip inspection fee or the special service fee?** No. The clause reduces plug-in fees only.

**Which percentage applies, the contract's or the reefer tier's?** The reefer tier's percentage from the table above; the contract only has to reach the qualifying rank.
